topics.title: Present Subjunctive Regular Stems & Conjugation (Subjonctif Présent - Régulier)
topics.objective: Form and apply the present subjunctive of regular -er, -ir, and -re verbs in dependent clauses after triggers expressing necessity, desire, and uncertainty.

topics.title: Irregular Subjunctive Verbs (Subjonctif des Verbes Irréguliers)
topics.objective: Correctly conjugate and employ high-frequency irregular verbs in the present subjunctive (*être, avoir, faire, aller, pouvoir, savoir, vouloir*).

topics.title: Subjunctive Semantic Triggers & Modal Matrix Clauses
topics.objective: Identify and systematically apply subjunctive mood across five primary semantic categories: Volition, Emotion, Impersonal Necessity, Doubt, and Complex Conjunctions.

topics.title: Subjunctive vs. Indicative Contrastive Syntax (Subjonctif ou Indicatif)
topics.objective: Contrast indicative and subjunctive usage based on clause polarity, assertion level, and matrix predicate certainty (*penser, croire, espérer, être certain*).

topics.title: Past Subjunctive (Subjonctif Passé)
topics.objective: Form and deploy the past subjunctive using present subjunctive auxiliaries (*avoir* / *être*) + past participle to express completed past actions in dependent clauses.
